meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Next Level Mentors collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

page.title: Privacy Policy
page.intro: This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. We keep it short and human.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect the information you give us directly — such as your name and email when you create an account or subscribe — and basic technical data like your device type and pages visited, which helps us improve the experience.
We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information to deliver the service: to send the episodes, articles, and event invites you ask for, to keep your account secure, and to understand which content is useful so we can make more of it.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use a small number of cookies to remember your preferences (such as light or dark mode) and to measure aggregate traffic. You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can update or delete your account at any time, and every email we send includes a one-click unsubscribe. To request a copy or deletion of your data, contact us at privacy@nextlevelmentors.show.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If we update this policy we'll revise the date above and, for material changes, let you know by email or an in-app notice.
